defect: The new __KernelSwitchToThread calls __KernelChangeReadyState(current, threadID, true) with the target thread's id instead of the current (idle) thread's id, corrupting the ready queue.
reason: The fix replaces threadID with currentThread in exactly this added line, and the function body shows current is the current thread while threadID is the switch target.

defect: The fix updates the list of ignored Vulkan validation message IDs (1810669668 replaced by 1243445977, more IDs added).
reason: Which validation-layer messages are suppressed is debug-log configuration, not a functional defect in the change.

defect: The fix adds an (int) cast to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning in ret != ATRAC_ERROR_BAD_ATRACID.
reason: The comparison already behaves correctly under the usual arithmetic conversions, so the fix is warning cleanup only.

defect: The fix casts ARRAY_SIZE to int in the sceGeGetCmd bounds check to silence a sign-comparison warning.
reason: cmd >= 0 is checked first, so the signed/unsigned comparison is already correct and the fix changes no behaviour.

defect: The rewritten check compares the unsigned (delaySlotOp & 0xFFFF) with the signed (signed short)(op & 0xFFFF) - 1, so for backward branches the int is converted to a huge unsigned value and a spurious 'different target' error report is raised.
reason: The fix sign-extends the left side in exactly the line this change rewrote, which changes the result for negative branch offsets, and the u32-versus-signed mismatch is visible in the diff.

defect: The new NiceTimeFormat fetches the DIALOG translation category into di but never uses it, so the seconds, minutes and hours strings are always shown untranslated.
reason: The fix wraps the three format strings added by this change in di->T_cstr, and the unused di variable is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix reworks clear-mode depth and stencil handling and only sets depth write when the depth test is enabled.
reason: The depth-write logic and the clear-mode stencil code that the fix repairs were not added by this change, and its edits to the non-clear stencil block only touch comments and braces.

defect: The new exponent-decrease step computes (rate_ + 3) / 4 with rate_ an int, which overflows (undefined behaviour, negative result) for rates near 0x7FFFFFFF.
reason: The fix makes this added expression unsigned, and seeing the overflow needs the int declaration of rate_ in SasAudio.h.

defect: The added '#ifdef __ANDROID__ && __ANDROID_API__ < 21' is an ill-formed directive: the extra tokens are ignored, so every Android build takes the 32-bit stat path regardless of API level.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added directive with a proper #if (defined __ANDROID__) && (__ANDROID_API__ < 21), and the misuse of #ifdef is plain in the diff.

defect: The fix sizes the two crash-screen columns from the screen width and adds a scissor so the first column cannot overlap the second.
reason: The fixed 400-pixel gap between the columns existed before this change (20 versus 420), so the overlap is pre-existing; the change only shifted both columns by the safe inset.

defect: The window title prefix was changed from 'PPSSPP v0.6 - ' to PPSSPP_VERSION_STR ' - ', which drops the product name because the macro expands to just '0.6.1'.
reason: The fix adds the missing 'PPSSPP ' in exactly this changed line, and knowing what the macro holds needs Core/Config.h.

defect: The fix shows iFrameSkip - 1 in the on-screen frameskip message, because value 1 means auto and 2 means skip one frame.
reason: The removed code already printed g_Config.iFrameSkip directly in the default case, so the off-by-one predates this change.

defect: When a mip level fails the new size check, the loop continues and later levels are pushed into levels_, so they land at the wrong level index.
reason: The fix adds a break after a bad level to the check this change added, and the skip-without-break is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix moves the 'Texture replacement pack activated' message from LoadIniValues to LoadIni so it also shows when there is no ini.
reason: The message was already shown only from LoadIniValues before this change, which only added a 2-second duration to it.

defect: The SDL main now passes a DummyGraphicsContext to NativeInitGraphics, but DummyGraphicsContext::CreateThin3DContext returns nullptr, so thin3d is null at startup.
reason: The fix replaces this added DummyGraphicsContext with a GLDummyGraphicsContext that returns T3DCreateGLContext(), and the null return is only visible in Common/GraphicsContext.h and NativeApp.cpp.

defect: The fix guards fbo binds against framebuffers that have no fbo (null after switching rendering mode) through RebindFramebuffer and dstBuffer->fbo checks.
reason: Unguarded binds of dstBuffer->fbo and currentRenderVfb_->fbo in buffered mode existed before this change, and the fix also repairs the same pattern in code the change never touched.

defect: The new RegCountToType returns type 4 for a four-register VLD1/VST1, but the ARM encoding for four registers is 0b0010, so n=4 loads and stores are mis-encoded.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added return value from 4 to 2, which a reviewer who knows the NEON encoding could see from the diff.

defect: The new Savedata Manager button looks up its label in the Networking translation category (n) instead of a Savedata category, so it is not translated correctly.
reason: The fix switches this added line to a Savedata category, and the use of the networking category n is visible in the diff.

defect: The added '#if !defined(_M_ARM64) && !defined(_M_ARM)' guards also disable the GLES backend on non-Windows ARM platforms such as Android, where _M_ARM is defined.
reason: The fix restricts these added guards to Windows, and seeing that _M_ARM is defined on non-Windows ARM needs Core/MemMap.h.

defect: The new SyncThread condition (eventsRunning_ || !eventsHaveRun_) keeps waiting forever when the event thread never started, for example on a forced stop before run.
reason: The fix replaces this added condition with ShouldSyncThread, which exits when the core is in error or powerdown; before the change, a non-running event loop ended the wait.

defect: The fix replaces the Symbian malloc fallback (UNUSABLE_MMAP, NULL memory base) with an RChunk-mapped virtual address range so that JIT and fastmem work on Symbian.
reason: The malloc path was a deliberate first Symbian port that admitted it had no base-relative addressing (used with SAFE_MEMORY); the fix is a redesign that adds JIT and fastmem support, not a repair of a slip.

defect: The fix removes the UNUSABLE_MMAP define that this change had moved into MemoryUtil.h.
reason: The define only becomes unnecessary once the RChunk mapping replaces the malloc fallback; the define itself causes no defect.

defect: The fix initialises origSize_ in the IRBlock constructors and copies it in the move constructor and move assignment.
reason: origSize_ was added by a later commit, so its missing initialisation and copy were not introduced by this change.

defect: The fix changes how the menu Exit button quits on Windows (posts WM_CLOSE) and moves the execution_character_set pragma under _MSC_VER.
reason: The exit crash is unrelated to this change, and moving the pragma only avoids an unknown-pragma warning on non-MSVC Windows compilers.

defect: The fix reorders the analog-stick entries in psp_button_names to Up, Down, Left, Right.
reason: This only changes the display order on the mapping screen, and the analog Left, Right, Down, Up order existed before this change.

defect: The fix corrects a copy-paste typo in Draw's assert from data.drawIndexed.uboOffsets to data.draw.uboOffsets.
reason: Both arrays are uint32_t[2], so the assert checked the same bound and the typo had no effect.

defect: The new depth-range clamping does 'far += overageFar' instead of 'far -= overageFar', so far is pushed further out of range and zScale and zOffset are wrong.
reason: The fix flips exactly this added operator, and the mismatch with the parallel near/left/right code is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix copies VFPU vector registers as u32 instead of float to work around a 32-bit MSVC fast-math issue that alters values on float copy.
reason: The float copies existed in the same form before this style refactor, so the issue is pre-existing.

defect: The new OnSavePathOther branch writes installed.txt with ofstream::open on a narrow UTF-8 path, which fails on Windows when the PPSSPP folder contains non-ANSI characters.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added ofstream lines with File::OpenCFile, and the diff shows the read side converting the same path with ConvertUTF8ToWString while the write side does not.

defect: The fix changes angle-bracket includes of Core headers to quoted includes and adds missing <mutex> and <deque> includes.
reason: <Core/Config.h> resolves through the include path like the existing <Core/CoreTiming.h>, and the missing standard headers predate this change, so this is include hygiene.

defect: The fix makes Event::Wait and Notify lock mutex_ (the unique_lock was default-constructed without a mutex) and adds a destructor that notifies.
reason: The mutex-less 'std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock;' existed before this change in both Wait and Notify; the change only moved it out of the if.

defect: The fix changes int to size_t for the find positions in trimString to silence sign warnings.
reason: Converting npos to int gives -1, which compares equal to npos again, so trimString already behaved correctly.

defect: The fix works around an Android exit crash by no longer registering OpenGLTexture as a GL resource holder and removing its GLLost and GLRestore.
reason: The texture's registration as a resource holder predates this change, and nothing shows that the GLLost split added here causes the exit crash.

defect: The fix initialises constantTable_ to NULL in the Thin3DDX9Shader constructor and rejects shader sets with a null shader.
reason: constantTable was already left uninitialised before this change, which only renamed the members.

defect: The fix removes the per-key switch cases now that a later key-queue mechanism reports the same keys, which had doubled key presses.
reason: The doubling comes from KeyQueueAddKey added by a later commit; this change only reformatted the switch and added PS3 key codes, which the fix keeps.

defect: The fix gives lastTimeSaved a 0.0 initialiser and adds an 'ignored' out-parameter to LookupHashFile.
reason: savedCache_ entries are created with operator[], which value-initialises lastTimeSaved to zero, and the texture-saving logic the fix repairs lies in the .cpp, not in this header change.

defect: The fix decides whether to save a decoded texture from plan.saveTexture && !lowMemoryMode_ instead of replacer_.Enabled() && plan.replaced->IsInvalid().
reason: plan.replaced is always set (FindNone otherwise), so the rewritten condition equals the old one; the saving bug comes from later replacer changes.

defect: The fix adds IOS to the platforms that skip the eglGetProcAddress VAO and discard-framebuffer lookups, fixing the iOS build.
reason: The iOS build break existed before this change, which only added MEEGO_EDITION_HARMATTAN to the existing Symbian condition.

defect: The fix binds the depal CLUT texture and sampler to slot 1, which the depal shader declares as register t1, instead of slot 3.
reason: TEX_SLOT_CLUT is 3 and the code bound slot 3 before this change as well, so the wrong slot predates it.

defect: The fix adds a disabled (#if 0) attempt to combine FPU writebacks with VSTMIA and moves FlushAll.
reason: This is an experimental feature left disabled; no defect from this change is repaired.
